lens: naming P10 + P14 BNF kebab-case + version-suffix + filename rules

findings.claim: `-v2` filename suffix is NOT the canonical version-bump pattern; docs/templates/INDEX.md:70 explicitly states the unsuffixed `adr-template.md` SUPERSEDES `adr-template-v2.md`, treating `-v2` as the older lifted-variant marker, not the new-version marker.
evidence: docs/templates/INDEX.md:89 -- `Lifted variants are saved as *-v2 files and supersede the prior files once reviewed.`

PR #15 adds `docs/templates/capability-record-template-v2.yaml` alongside existing `capability-record-template.yaml` -- inverts the documented supersession semantics: new content should land at the unsuffixed name with the old file retired, not as a *-v2 sibling.

Resulting state: two divergent capability-record templates coexist with no SUPERSEDES marker in either, contradicting INDEX.md TPL-CAP row (line 38) which already lists `capability-record-template-v2.yaml` while line 70 retires the *-v2 pattern.
findings.fix: Either (a) delete `capability-record-template.yaml` and keep only the -v2 file with an INDEX.md SUPERSEDES note, or (b) merge -v2 content into the unsuffixed name and delete the -v2 file. Add an ADR or update naming-justification policy clarifying which file is canonical.

findings.claim: `.omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.<UUID>` filename schema is NOT sanctioned anywhere: not in `.gitignore`, not in `docs/standards/`, not in any ADR. Six such files were committed in PR #15 and remain on disk.
evidence: PR #15 diff lines 2-67 modify six `.omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.<UUID>` files -- these look like crash-orphaned write-temp files that should be cleaned up, not version-controlled.
No documented filename schema for `.tmp.<UUID>` suffix exists under `docs/standards/` (only `crate-naming-convention.md` present); no ADR sanctions the pattern.
Pattern violates P10 hygiene: UUID-suffixed tmp files indicate atomic-write race-condition residue from the OMC project-memory writer, not intentional artifacts.
findings.fix: Add `.omc/*.tmp.*` (and ideally `.omc/.*.tmp.*`) to `.gitignore`; remove the six committed tmp files via follow-up PR; file an issue against the OMC writer that leaks them.

findings.claim: Template-name shape consistency: `capability-eval-set-template.yaml` and `capability-record-template.yaml` follow kebab-case `<domain>-<artifact>-template.yaml` cleanly; both are P14-compliant. No drift here on naming shape itself.
findings.fix: None for shape; only the -v2 supersession issue (A1-1) applies.

findings.claim: ADR-0116 is cited in PR body as the governing decision for the topology move but no ADR is cited for the version-bump-via-v2-suffix decision. PR rationale `'no new ADR added because this is a mechanical topology move'` skips the naming-policy justification required by the project memory directive `feedback_naming_justification` (every new name must carry one-line justification proving v4 BNF + 12-layer-enum conformance at scaffold time).
evidence: PR #15 body: `ADRs cited: ADR-0116; Foundry pipeline M01-P18; no new ADR added because this is a mechanical topology move`
PR #15 body 'Naming justification' block covers `registry/capability-templates/` and four artifact-row ids -- does NOT justify the `-v2` template filename or the .tmp.<UUID> commits.
MEMORY.md feedback_naming_justification: `Every new name must carry one-line justification proving v4 BNF + 12-layer-enum conformance at scaffold time`.
findings.fix: Backfill an ADR (or extend ADR-0116) covering (i) template version-bump filename convention, (ii) .omc tmp-file hygiene policy. Until then, naming-justification gate is incomplete for this PR.

open_questions: Is there an off-repo OMC spec sanctioning `.tmp.<UUID>` as the project-memory atomic-write staging shape? If yes, cite it in `.gitignore` rather than commit the files.

Was `capability-record-template-v2.yaml` intended to land in the path-versioned `docs/templates/v2/` directory per any prior planning artifact? If so, the file is misplaced; if not, the -v2 suffix needs explicit policy.
consensus_summary: PR #15's directory rename `product-control/` -> `registry/capability-templates/` is clean and well-justified. However, the PR also (a) accepts the `-v2` filename suffix as a versioning pattern that the canonical template INDEX explicitly retires, (b) commits six UUID-suffixed atomic-write tmp files with no sanctioning policy or .gitignore entry, and (c) skips naming-justification for both. Two MAJOR drifts; recommend follow-up cleanup PR.
